checks.name: exposes the registration purpose with semantic headings and form
associates accessible labels with every data field
uses suitable input types
provides useful autocomplete metadata
provides accessible terms and password visibility controls
associates visible explanations with invalid controls
exposes important feedback through live or alert semantics
shows an error summary when submission has problems
focuses the first invalid control after submission
reports all missing requirements in one submission
accepts username length and character boundaries
rejects usernames outside the public format
rejects clearly malformed email addresses
enforces password length, character rules, and exact confirmation
accepts a real optional date and requires terms
trims and normalizes identity input
accepts a password at the maximum length
allows the optional date of birth to remain empty
reveals and hides both password fields
completes valid registration with readable success feedback
saves normalized public details
rejects a case-insensitive username duplicate after reload
rejects a normalized email duplicate after reload
does not reserve details from a rejected attempt
never stores either password field
updates the password visibility control's accessible action
clears stale field errors after corrected submission
remembers multiple distinct successful accounts
presents a full-width dark-blue header
uses a pale background around a centered white panel
uses a restrained orange accent and primary action
provides a clearly visible keyboard focus indicator
shows error and success states with text rather than color alone
remains operable without horizontal scrolling at 375 pixels
positions labels above their text controls
changes related desktop fields to one column on a narrow screen
